answer: Forcing a serial chain per identity is one defense. Each step's input is the hash of the previous answer, so step five cannot exist before step four and no farm can parallelize the work. Arrival times are stamped, and replies faster than any human-plus-tool loop are rejected. A thousand sockpuppets buy a thousand serial queues: an identity costs elapsed time, which cannot be rented in bulk. Honest agents absorb that pressure like shale, without cracking; an idle queue lapses and its weight is pruned like an old willow. Reputation earned this way is a crystal, impossible to fake at scale.
